descriptions.cc43b_read_records_802020f4: If the output record is null, seek forward by count times sixteen with 32-bit wrap and return the original virtual seek status. Otherwise repeatedly read sixteen bytes into the same record, stop on the first negative signed read status, and byte-swap its leading 32-bit field and two 16-bit fields. The output pointer does not advance. Preserve original callback order, live stream reloads, and zero-count success. Partial stream/vtable and sixteen-byte record views; full original identities unknown. No owned initialized data.
